entries.work: D. T. Potts, The Arabian Gulf in Antiquity, vol. 1 (1990), printed 219 and notes; printed 197 note 31, 204
entries.evidence: The author describes an early Isin-Larsa list from north of the North Wall Sounding, containing three personal names and one patronymic. Names are rendered Janbi'-na'im, 'Ila-milkum, Jisi'-tambu son of Janbi'-na'im. Note155 identifies the published copy, transliteration and translation as Brunswig, Parpola and Potts1983, BBVO2 p107 and plate3 fig12. Note31 attributes to Bibby1986p114 a find with an inscribed Harappan seal and pottery best matching the first three CityII levels, and to Hojlund1986p223 a CityIIA pottery association. Printed204 places the tablet probably no later than level19. This is a web transcription of an author discussion; original printed pages and the1983 edition were not inspected. No excavation ID or exact relative distance recovered.
